title: Holiday Traditions

passage.speaker: Friend
passage.text: Can you tell me about it?

passage.speaker: You
passage.text: In my country, families gather on New Year's Eve for a large meal.

passage.speaker: You
passage.text: At midnight, we watch fireworks and exchange small gifts.

passage.speaker: You
passage.text: It's a tradition that brings generations together.

tip: Try speaking the 'You' response out loud to practice your pronunciation!
